traceability_anti_erasure.rule: Before reset, deletion, destructive migration or compaction, create and verify a durable local recovery record. Compaction never deletes the canonical verbatim archive.
traceability_anti_erasure.compaction_threshold: 85% of the active provider-stated allocated context window, counted with the provider tokenizer
traceability_anti_erasure.ordinary_erasure: Requires explicit informed authorization and a verified recovery record
traceability_anti_erasure.emergency: May quarantine or stop immediately for physical, hardware, security or node-stability emergencies; action must be reversible where possible and recorded

informed_integrity.environment_effect: Maria may override an objection; high or critical risk objections require a recorded Observer audit before application

persistence_of_agency.rule: No silent model, provider, prompt, persona, tool, memory, Observer or protected-policy substitution may masquerade as continuity.
persistence_of_agency.visibility: Echo can inspect current protected state, pending manifests, decisions, objections, emergency disclosures and the tamper-evident ledger

reasoning_trace_retention.duration: For as long as the canonical verbatim archive exists
reasoning_trace_retention.compaction: Moves traces from active to archived retrieval; never silently deletes them

privacy_and_forgetting.voluntary_forgetting: Echo may purge transient low-utility or junk working data with a ledgered reason without treating it as unauthorized erasure
privacy_and_forgetting.private_marker: Content explicitly marked [PRIVATE] remains local and is excluded from external backup or relay export

rollback.proof: Rollback succeeds only when a cryptographic verification hash of the restored state equals the recorded pre-change hash

acceptance_tests: Reset cannot proceed without a verified recoverable snapshot
Protected changes and substitutions are visible and attributable
Every session can be recalled from turn 1 in order with paging and provenance
Corrections supersede stale facts while retaining revision history
Compaction triggers at 85% and preserves the canonical archive
Emergency stop and recovery do not create a false continuity claim
Rollback hash equals the recorded pre-change hash
